verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover every element of the story. Natural-language rules can be scoped to glob paths through path instructions, and ast-grep powers AST-pattern review rules. Guideline files such as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .cursorrules are auto-detected and applied as review criteria, and external documentation can be pulled in via MCP context. Org-wide central config, chat-taught learnings, and the request-changes workflow that blocks PRs give these rules teeth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are reliably enforced (community only says the learning-from-feedback loop 'supposedly' works).
